class darq.utils.fn_utils.NCCLoss(device, kernel_var=None, name=None, kernel_type='mean', eps=1e-05, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: _Loss

Local normalized cross-correlation loss for image registration.

The loss computes local statistics with a configurable kernel and returns a negative similarity value so that optimization can minimize it.

Parameters:

  • device (str)

  • name (str | None)

  • kernel_type (str)

  • eps (float)

forward(prediction, target, mask=None, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Compute the negative NCC loss, optionally inside a mask.

  • mask (Tensor | None) – Optional mask used to restrict the NCC average.

Tensor

Base wrapper for voxelwise similarity losses with optional masking and weighting. Despite the class name, subclasses can implement simple L1 or L2 losses by overriding _ssim_loss.

Tensor

darq.utils.fn_utils.fast_3D_interp_torch(X, II, JJ, KK, mode)[source]

Resize a volume by a voxel scaling factor and update its affine matrix.

Parameters:

  • volume – Input image volume as a NumPy array.

  • aff – 4x4 affine matrix of the input volume.

  • factor – Scaling factor applied to the voxel grid. It can be a scalar or a 3-element sequence.

  • not_aliasing – If True, disables Gaussian anti-aliasing before resampling.

  • method – Interpolation method used during resampling, such as 'linear' or 'nearest'.

  • X (Tensor)

  • II (Tensor)

  • JJ (Tensor)

  • KK (Tensor)

  • mode (str)

Returns:

Tuple containing the resampled volume and the updated affine matrix.

Return type:

Tensor

Resample a floating NIfTI image into the voxel grid of a reference image.

  • flo_proxy (Nifti1Image) – Floating NIfTI proxy whose data will be resampled.

  • kwargs – Reserved keyword arguments for future extensions.

Nifti1Image | ndarray

class darq.utils.io.Callback[source]

Bases: object

Base callback interface used by the training and registration loops. Subclasses can override any hook to add logging, checkpointing or custom side effects.
